QuestInfo.name: A Peaceful World
QuestInfo.0: Something still doesn't feel quite right... Talk to #p9110106#.
QuestInfo.1: You completely forgot about #p9110103#! #p9110106# suggested you give her the #t04000345#, which should help her father return to normal. \n\n#t04000345# #b#c04000345##k/1
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #t04000345# to #p9110103# and she came up with a plan to scare #p9110112# straight.

0.0: #p9110112#'s daughter, #p9110103#, was the one who sent you to investigate the castle in the first place, right?
0.1: That gentleman is a bad seed, if you ask me, but maybe a few whacks about the head with this #b#t04000345##k will remind him that his sweet #p9110103# is worth more than some filthy coins.

yes.0: I'm sure you'll enjoy the show. Toodles!

no.0: You're right. #p9110103# can probably handle the old man by herself.

1.0: Where have you been? When I sent you off to deal with the toad, I didn't know you were planning to take a vacation in the middle.
1.1: (You hand the #t04000345# to #p9110103# and explain what happened.)
1.2: I knew it! I knew that old goat was getting greedy! You just wait until he sees me with this #t04000345#. Then you'll see what a scared old fart looks like!
1.3: You know I made this for him? Now it's gonna bruise his wrinkled old noggin until he promises that he's NEVER gonna get into dealing illegal goods EVER again. I'm not taking that old brainwashing excuse this time, lemme tell ya!

npc.0: You can get the #b#t04000345##k from the #bPhantom of the Giant Ghost Ship#k. If you already have it, take it over to #p9110103#.
